equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity is shown only in Table 1, with AI/AN, NH/OPI and multiple race collapsed into other and 6–8% missing; age and sex serve as stratifiers because of their association with cardiac outcomes.

notes: RRs are unadjusted ratios of cumulative incidence computed from aggregated query results, so no regression is involved; aggregation precluded confounder adjustment. The cohort design is inferred from 'cohorts' built from existing EHR records. Incidence within fixed risk windows is read as a risk (binary/categorical), not a rate.
view_issues: Summary says risk was significantly higher in all age groups, but males 5–11 had several nonsignificant or NC RRs and females 5–11 had no RRs (no vaccine cases). Text calls all male 12–17 RRs significant, but one is 1.8 (1.0–3.1). Male 12–17 first-dose 42-day RR (4.9) looks inconsistent with the 7- and 21-day values.
